messages.content: "Can you help me with a couple of conversions? First, I have 5000 Euros that I want to convert into US Dollars using the latest exchange rate. Then, I have another 3000 Euros that I want to convert into British Pounds, but this time, I want to use the last known exchange rate. After that, I have a distance of 100 kilometers that I want to convert into miles. Lastly, I have a weight of 75 kilograms that I want to convert into pounds. Can you do these conversions for me?"

function.name: unit_conversion_convert
function.description: Converts a value from one unit to another. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: currency_exchange_convert
function.description: Converts a value from one currency to another using the latest exchange rate. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

amount.description: The amount of money to be converted.

live_conversion.description: If true, use the latest exchange rate for conversion, else use the last known rate. Default is true.

Then unit conversions: 100 km to miles, 75 kg to pounds. We have two functions: currency_exchange_convert and unit_conversion_convert. We'll call them accordingly.

We need to produce calls to the functions. The user wants all conversions. We can call each function separately. The order: first currency conversion 5000 EUR to USD live. Then 3000 EUR to GBP last known. Then 100 km to miles. Then 75 kg to pounds.

We need to output function calls. According to policy, we should not provide any other text. Just the function calls. So we will produce four function calls. Use the function names exactly: currency_exchange_convert and unit_conversion_convert. Provide arguments as JSON.

We need to ensure correct syntax. For currency_exchange_convert: amount: 5000, from_currency: "EUR", to_currency: "USD", live_conversion: true. For second: amount: 3000, from_currency: "EUR", to_currency: "GBP", live_conversion: false.

For unit_conversion_convert: value: 100, from_unit: "km", to_unit: "mi". For weight: value: 75, from_unit: "kg", to_unit: "lb".

We need to output each function call. The format: 
{
  "name": "currency_exchange_convert",
  "arguments": { ... }
}

We need to output multiple calls. According to guidelines, we can output multiple calls sequentially. So we produce four separate JSON objects. Ensure no extra text.
